eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter Eight
subtitle: Lesson 35 · Database Integrity & Maintenance

code:
SELECT file_id,
    (total_page_count * 8) / 1024 AS total_mb,
    (allocated_extent_page_count * 8) / 1024 AS used_mb,
    ((total_page_count - allocated_extent_page_count) * 8)
        / 1024 AS free_mb
FROM sys.dm_db_file_space_usage;
caption: Run against tempdb: is it actually full, or just busy?

eyebrow: Free space at the volume level
code:
SELECT DISTINCT vs.volume_mount_point,
    vs.total_bytes / 1024/1024/1024 AS total_gb,
    vs.available_bytes / 1024/1024/1024 AS free_gb
FROM sys.master_files AS mf
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(
    mf.database_id, mf.file_id) AS vs;
caption: The same free-space number Explorer shows, queryable in T-SQL.
